id: 05_Test Your Basic Fire Safety Knowledge Fire Safety Quiz Fire Quiz Fire Safety MCQ
title: 消防基础自测：十道题测测你（国内版）
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/05_Test Your Basic Fire Safety Knowledge Fire Safety Quiz Fire Quiz Fire Safety MCQ.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/05_Test Your Basic Fire Safety Knowledge Fire Safety Quiz Fire Quiz Fire Safety MCQ（国内版）/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一张空白测验卡，身旁是消防车图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank quiz card next to a small fire truck icon and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 十道消防基础题，测测你！
overlay: 消防基础自测：十道题测测你

shots.scene: 阿杰在通风柜前做实验，突然警铃响
shots.prompt_en: The young male student works at a fume hood when a fire alarm bell suddenly rings in the corridor.
shots.narration: 警铃响了，阿杰的实验还差最后一步。

shots.scene: 阿杰犹豫地看看实验，又看看门口
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hesitates, looking back and forth between his experiment and the door.
shots.narration: 他犹豫：做完再走，还是马上走？

shots.scene: 欣欣在门口招手，示意他出来
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves from the doorway, signaling him to come out.
shots.narration: 答案在第九题，我们一题题来。

shots.scene: 十张空白题卡排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Ten blank quiz cards in a row on a table. No people.
shots.narration: 每题四个选项，选出正确的。

shots.scene: 木块、塑料盒、纸张和四个分类框
shots.prompt_en: A wooden block, a plastic box and paper sheets next to four blank category boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：木材、塑料、纸张属哪类火？

shots.scene: 三样东西落入同一个框，框上画固体块图标
shots.prompt_en: The three items drop into one box marked with a solid block icon. No people.
shots.narration: 它们都是固体，属于A类火。

shots.scene: 实验台下的纸箱、泡沫塑料被清走
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student removes cardboard boxes and foam packaging from under a lab bench.
shots.narration: 包装纸箱和泡沫，及时清出实验室。

shots.scene: 磨光机火花、切割火花、焊接火花三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with sparks: an angle grinder on metal, a cutting torch and a welding torch. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：哪些活儿算动火作业？

shots.scene: 三个图标一起打勾
shots.prompt_en: All three spark icons get green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 磨削金属、切割、焊接，都算。

shots.scene: 火花溅到旁边纸箱上冒烟的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of sparks landing on a nearby cardboard box that starts to smoke. No people.
shots.narration: 飞溅的火花，能点着周围的可燃物。

shots.scene: 老李拿着焊接设备，王老师递给他空白审批单
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands a blank hot work permit to the facility engineer who carries welding equipment.
shots.narration: 实验楼里动火，先办审批。

shots.scene: 老李清走周围的试剂瓶和纸箱，铺上防火毯
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer moves reagent bottles and boxes away and lays a fire blanket on the floor.
shots.narration: 清走周围可燃物，备好灭火器材。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员在旁监火，完工后用手电检查
shots.prompt_en: The security officer stands by as fire watch, then checks the area with a flashlight after the work.
shots.narration: 有人监火，完工后再检查有无余火。

shots.scene: 三个口诀卡片，其中一张亮起
shots.prompt_en: Three blank acronym cards; one lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：用灭火器的口诀是哪个？

shots.scene: 四个手势图标：拔销、对准、压把、扫射
shots.prompt_en: Four step icons: pulling a pin, aiming a nozzle, squeezing a handle and sweeping. No people.
shots.narration: 拔、瞄、压、扫，四步口诀。

shots.scene: 小研在培训场地对着火盆根部扫射
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sweeps an extinguisher at the base of a training tray fire.
shots.narration: 对准火焰根部，左右扫射。

shots.scene: 小研灭火，身后是绿色安全出口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fights a small fire with a green emergency exit sign behind her.
shots.narration: 第四题：灭火时怎么站？

shots.scene: 朝南朝北的指南针图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A compass icon pointing north and south, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 和东南西北无关。

shots.scene: 背后出口的箭头亮起
shots.prompt_en: An arrow from the person's back to the exit lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 背对出口，面向火，退路在身后。

shots.scene: 烟雾中一个人被困，旁边有人在安全处
shots.prompt_en: In a smoky room, one person is trapped near the fire while others are safe near the door.
shots.narration: 第五题：着火了，先救谁？

shots.scene: 被困者头顶红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A red exclamation icon above the trapped person.
shots.narration: 先救处在直接危险中的人。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员拿着空白名单清点
shots.prompt_en: The security officer checks a blank list to make sure no one is left behind.
shots.narration: 清点人数，确认没人被落下。

shots.scene: 人与火之间一条虚线
shots.prompt_en: A dashed line between a person icon and a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：灭火时离火多远？

shots.scene: 太近被热浪烤的图标打叉，合适距离的图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon too close to the flame with heat waves crossed out, and one at a safe distance checked. No people.
shots.narration: 原题答三米，实际要看火势和灭火器。

shots.scene: 小研站在上风处，保持距离
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands upwind at a safe distance from a training fire.
shots.narration: 站在上风，离火保持安全距离。

shots.scene: 红色三角形，三边是火焰、木块、空气图标
shots.prompt_en: A red triangle with a flame, a block of wood and an air swirl on its sides. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：火三角是哪三样？

shots.scene: 二氧化碳分子图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A carbon dioxide molecule icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 热、氧气、可燃物；二氧化碳反而灭火。

shots.scene: 四个图标：熔断的小金属片、热棒、太阳光线、上升气流
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a small melting metal link, a hot metal rod, radiating heat rays and rising hot air. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：哪个不是热传递方式？

shots.scene: 热棒、光线、气流三个图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: The hot rod, heat rays and rising air icons light up. No people.
shots.narration: 传导、辐射、对流，才是热传递。

shots.scene: 喷头里的玻璃球和防火门上的小金属片受热断开
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a sprinkler head glass bulb and a small metal link on a fire door closer breaking apart with heat. No people.
shots.narration: 易熔元件是受热就断开的触发装置。

shots.scene: 加热板旁边的溶剂瓶被挪远
shots.prompt_en: Solvent bottles are moved away from a hot plate on a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 热源旁的辐射热，能烤着易燃物。

shots.scene: 刚关掉的加热板上，手被烫的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand touching a recently switched-off hot plate, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 关了的加热板，余热还会烫伤。

shots.scene: 热烟向上涌、沿天花板扩散
shots.prompt_en: Hot smoke rising and spreading along a ceiling. No people.
shots.narration: 热烟向上走，所以逃生要低姿。

shots.scene: 楼道里的防火门被灭火器顶着敞开，画红叉
shots.prompt_en: A corridor fire door propped open with a fire extinguisher, crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 防火门别用东西顶开。

shots.scene: 防火门关闭，门后烟被挡住
shots.prompt_en: A closed fire door holding back smoke on the other side. No people.
shots.narration: 平时关着，着火时才能挡住烟火。

shots.scene: 门前堆放杂物的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of boxes piled in front of a fire door, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 门前也不能堆东西。

shots.scene: 警铃响，四个选项图标：应急程序、引导员、实验装置、集合点
shots.prompt_en: An alarm bell rings beside four icons: an emergency plan sheet, a person with a vest, an experiment setup and an assembly point. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：紧急时，哪件事不用管？

shots.scene: 实验装置图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The experiment setup icon is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是：完成实验。

shots.scene: 应急程序、引导员、集合点三个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: The emergency plan, the person in a vest and the assembly point icons get green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 要记住应急程序、听引导员、去集合点。

shots.scene: 阿杰放下实验，跟着小研走出门
shots.prompt_en: The young male student leaves his experiment and follows the female graduate student out of the lab.
shots.narration: 阿杰放下实验，立即离开。

shots.scene: 阿杰伸手关掉加热板和气阀，只用了一下
shots.prompt_en: The young male student quickly switches off a hot plate and closes a gas valve with one motion.
shots.narration: 几秒能做到的，顺手关热源和气源。

shots.scene: 火已经蔓延，阿杰直接撤离
shots.prompt_en: Flames spread on the bench; the young male student leaves immediately without touching anything.
shots.narration: 做不到，就别管，立即撤。

shots.scene: 王老师指着空白应急预案
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points to a blank emergency plan on the wall.
shots.narration: 具体做法，按本校应急预案执行。

shots.scene: 三个图标：移走的木块、盖子、水滴
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a wooden block being moved away, a lid over a pan and a water drop. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：灭火有哪些方法？

shots.scene: 三个图标依次亮起打勾
shots.prompt_en: The three icons light up one by one with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 隔离可燃物、隔绝空气、降低温度。

shots.scene: 实验台上小火被灭火毯盖住
shots.prompt_en: A small fire on a lab bench is covered by a fire blanket. No people.
shots.narration: 台面小火，灭火毯一盖就是窒息法。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起两块空白牌子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up two blank boards.
shots.narration: 消防培训常说：四懂四会。

shots.scene: 四个图标：火焰警示、盾牌、灭火器、逃生箭头
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a fire warning triangle, a shield, a fire extinguisher and an escape arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 懂危险、懂预防、懂扑救、懂逃生。

shots.scene: 四个图标：电话、灭火器、小火、人群疏散
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a telephone, a fire extinguisher, a small flame and a group walking to an exit. No people.
shots.narration: 会报警、会用器材、会灭小火、会疏散。

shots.scene: 小研按下手动报警按钮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student presses a manual fire alarm call point.
shots.narration: 发现火情，先按报警按钮。

shots.scene: 阿杰打电话
shots.prompt_en: The young male student makes an urgent phone call outside the lab.
shots.narration: 拨打119，同时报告实验室负责人。

shots.scene: 王老师合上法规书，提示图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator closes a blank rule book with a reminder icon.
shots.narration: 具体程序，以现行规定和本校制度为准。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard with fire safety icons.
shots.narration: 十题答完，回顾一下。

shots.scene: 图标：A类火、动火审批、四步口诀
shots.prompt_en: Icons: a solid block, a signed permit and four extinguisher step icons. No people.
shots.narration: 固体是A类，动火先审批，灭火四步走。

shots.scene: 图标：背对出口、实验装置打叉、集合点
shots.prompt_en: Icons: a person with an exit behind, a crossed-out experiment setup and an assembly point. No people.
shots.narration: 背对出口灭火，紧急时别管实验。

shots.scene: 阿杰在集合点竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands at the assembly point and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：命比实验重要。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 消防知识常温习，下次见！
